I am…

Zenia. I put colour where there is grey.

I am Zenia Pavlidou, Evgenia on paper, and I am a certified NeuroGraphica® Instructor, the method created by psychologist and artist Pavel Piskarev. I bring the method to Greece through workshops, one-to-one sessions and our beloved Sundays at NeuroCafe_Athens.

For me, the marker in my hand is not “work”. It is my way of creating, inspiring and meeting wonderful people. Again and again I have seen what happens when someone watches their line change under their hand: the way they see their question changes too.

My wish is simple: that everyone who comes close to me takes something beautiful with them. A little more joy. A little strength. Inspiration. Light. And the wish to believe more in themselves and in all they can still create.

Strongly. Creatively. Authentically. With love, with colour and with a lot of light.Zenia

The method

What is NeuroGraphica®?

NeuroGraphica is a creative method of self-knowledge and personal growth. We draw free “neurolines”, round off the corners where the lines meet and bring colour into the fields. As the drawing changes, so does the picture we hold of a topic: a worry, a decision, a relationship, a goal.

It is not a drawing class and needs no talent. It is an honest dialogue with yourself, in the language of line and colour. It works even when your topic is hard to put into words.

The method was born in 2014 with Pavel Piskarev, psychologist and artist, and today it is taught in dozens of countries and many languages. In Greece I teach it as a certified instructor.

Draw your first neuroline

Think of something on your mind. Draw one line without lifting your finger or mouse, any way it comes out.

Step by step

How a drawing works

Every drawing follows an “algorithm”: a series of simple steps that take you from a question to a new picture.

  1. 01

    The question

    We start with what is on your mind. You do not need the perfect words; a feeling, a mood or an image is enough.

  2. 02

    The neuroline

    You let your hand draw a free line, without thinking how it “should” look. Your line reflects your own path.

  3. 03

    Rounding & colour

    We round off the corners where the lines meet, connect the shapes and bring colour into the fields.

  4. 04

    A new picture

    We look at the drawing together. As it changed under your hand, the way you see your question often changes too.

Topics

What we can work on together

In NeuroGraphica there is no limit to the topic. Any personal or professional request can become a drawing.

  • Emotions & states

    Anxiety, anger, guilt, apathy, inner conflict: whatever needs room to be seen and worked through.

  • Relationships & roots

    Family, partner, children, colleagues. The drawing makes hidden links and tensions visible, and the NeuroTree takes us back to our roots.

  • Choices & decisions

    A dilemma, a change of direction, a lack of clarity. The paper brings order to the chaos and joins reason with intuition.

  • Money & abundance

    Beliefs about money, blocks, self-worth. Working with the line opens a new way of thinking.

  • Creativity & inspiration

    When you want to step out of the “blank” and find your flow again, we draw the flow.

  • Goals, meaning & new beginnings

    A move, studies, a new career, a book: every personal or professional project can become the subject of our work.

And if you don’t have a request yet? That is perfectly normal. We start from a feeling, a mood or an image, and the drawing brings the essence to the surface.

Training

Learn NeuroGraphica® in three levels

From personal experience, to professional practice, to teaching. Each level is one step higher, and you go as far as you want.

  1. 1

    The first level

    Basic User

    You get to know the philosophy of NeuroGraphica®, learn the line, the shape, the connection and five core algorithms to work on your own topics.

    Official programme ↗
  2. 2

    The professional level

    Specialist

    You understand in depth how the algorithms work, use the different models of the method and learn to guide processes and sessions with others.

  3. 3

    The highest level

    Instructor

    The method becomes a teaching tool: you go deeper into the methodology, design training programmes and become able to teach NeuroGraphica® officially.

    Official programme ↗

Do I need to know how to draw?
No. NeuroGraphica is for everyone, even for people who believe they cannot draw. What matters is not how beautiful the line is, but what it shows you.
What is NeuroGraphica®?
It is a creative method of self-knowledge and personal growth that combines art, psychology and neuroscience. Psychologist and artist Pavel Piskarev created it in 2014 and today it is taught in dozens of countries. We draw free lines, round off their corners and colour the fields, while working on a personal topic.
Is it psychotherapy?
No. NeuroGraphica is a tool for self-knowledge and creative empowerment. It does not replace psychotherapy or medical care; if you need therapeutic support, please turn to a mental-health professional.
Can I join online?
Yes. The NeuroCafe_Athens Sundays, many themed workshops and the one-to-one sessions also take place online, wherever you are.
What do I need to bring?
For in-person workshops we have all the materials: you only bring yourself. For online sessions I tell you beforehand what to have ready: paper, a black marker and a few colours.
How long is a workshop?
A themed workshop usually lasts about three hours. Themed cycles have several meetings, one a week. Before every booking I tell you the exact length.
Is it suitable for children?
Both adults and children learn the method. For children’s groups or schools, send me a message and we will arrange it.
Can I become an instructor too?
Yes. The training has three levels: Basic User, Specialist and Instructor. You start from the first and go as far as you want.
How do I book a place?
Send me a message on WhatsApp or Viber, call me on +30 690 627 8106 or write to me by e-mail. Places in workshops are limited, so the group stays small and safe.
